name: Taï National Park
description: Taï National Park protects about 3,300 square kilometres of dense rainforest in southwestern Côte d'Ivoire, near the Liberian border and roughly 100 kilometres inland from the coast. It is one of West Africa's last large stretches of untouched primary forest. Its canopy shelters pygmy hippos, leopards, chimpanzees, and 11 kinds of monkey, including the rare olive colobus.
